verdict.rationale: Sentry's OTLP concepts page says it ingests OpenTelemetry traces and logs through OTLP endpoints, sent directly from an OTel SDK or through the OpenTelemetry Collector. That covers the core of sending telemetry directly over OTLP. Missing for 10: evidence of OTLP metrics ingestion, any detail on how deep the OTel support goes (semantic conventions, endpoint configuration, limits), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
